title: Only triage watches the page; each item names who wakes; one home per answer; a relayed grant carries the owner's exact words
why: Owner R18, 16:46-16:57 CST Nov 10 (relayed by the retrospective session): "the process of what's being woken, and how to pass words along / relays needs to be vastly improved"; 16:54 "too many sessions seem too tapped in to the artifact"; 16:55 "relayed grants need to come in more easily and more intuitively ... we never protect against maliciousness only carelessness/negligence", points 1-4 agreed; 16:57 "it should also be known by sessions how to carry my grant".
note: (1) Only triage watches the page. (2) Each item names who wakes; triage messages exactly those (page link, item id, pick). (3) One home per answer, the page; chat holds 'on the page, item N'; a hook moves a question with options from a reply onto the page; a chat answer goes onto the page at once. (4) Never reply in a page comment thread; a hook enforces it (folds step page-thread-reply-refused). (5) A relay counts when it carries `Grant: "<exact words>" (owner, <time>) covers <act>`; a guard in the sender checks the words are in its feedback log; the receiver acts with no page round-trip; other shapes are refused with the form as remedy. Home: skill waiting-page; decision relayed-grant-read-from-page. Plan stage 4, commit 523b044c8. Lane prose-waiting-page started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
